description: Upload package to TestPyPI safely: install twine, upload with --repository testpypi flag, uses TestPyPI credentials or API token.

steps.description: Setup and upload: pip install twine, twine upload --repository testpypi dist/*.
Credentials: twine prompts for TestPyPI username/password or uses API token from test.pypi.org.

title: TestPyPI: Upload to Test Registry
